pages.text: A wedge cut from a The-End Cake.$(br)Grants the eater:$(br)$(li)66 seconds of Nourishment$(li)66 seconds of The Pale Messenger$(li)66 seconds of Resistance IV$(li)66 seconds of Strength X$(li)66 seconds of Luck X
Beyond those, it also grants $(thing)66 seconds of Resistance VI$() and $(thing)stops time in the entire world$().$(br2)The last sweet bite the End Deity leaves for the faithful.
